tables.description: per size X and bound B: u = ln X / ln B, count of consecutive integers, smooth count, observed density and its Poisson standard error, rho(u), the derivative form rho + rho'/ln B, the de Bruijn local form rho + gamma rho'/ln B, and observed over each
tables.name: points

tables.description: the conditional baseline, pooled over the sizes: per bin [ln_c_lo, ln_c_hi) of the cofactor c = n / s(n), with s(n) the part of n made of primes up to rough_bound, and per bound B: the count of integers whose cofactor falls in the bin, their mean ln c, u = mean ln c / ln B, the count of those that are B-smooth, the observed density Q_B(c) and its Poisson standard error, and for reference the unconditional de Bruijn local form at u with observed over it. Bin 0 holds the integers with c = 1
tables.name: cofactor
